evidence: This is a terrain/ground tile block (4x3 tiles of sci-fi metal floor plating). As a flat floor surface, it is drawn entirely as a top-down horizontal plane, which is appropriate for terrain.

style.evidence: The steel plates use 4-5 blue-grey tones (plus 2 cyan tones for the light), with dark slate seam lines. However, compared to the Beodeul paving reference, each 16x16 panel has fairly blocky, repetitive geometry with 5x5+ areas of flat colour and the exact same 4 tiles repeated identically across all 3 rows, resulting in lower visual density and organic/hand-crafted variation.
